title: What is PM-KISAN and Why Are Farmers Getting Money This Week?
description: The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme gives financial support to eligible farmer families in India. Each eligible family receives ₹6,000 per.

faq.a: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land are eligible, subject to certain exclusion criteria. These include institutional landholders, government employees, professionals, and those who pay income tax.

faq.q: How often do farmers receive the PM-KISAN amount?
faq.a: Farmers receive ₹2,000 every four months, making it three instalments of ₹2,000 each, totalling ₹6,000 per year.

faq.q: What documents are needed to apply for PM-KISAN?
faq.a: Farmers need their Aadhaar card, bank account details (linked to Aadhaar), and land records to apply and receive benefits. eKYC completion is also mandatory.

faq.q: What if a farmer does not receive an instalment?
faq.a: If an eligible farmer doesn't receive an instalment, they should check their beneficiary status on the PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or contact the scheme's helpline numbers (155261 / 011-24300606 / 1800-11-5526). Issues often arise due to incomplete eKYC, unlinked Aadhaar-bank accounts, or incorrect land records.

faq.q: Can a husband and wife both receive PM-KISAN benefits?
faq.a: No, only one member from a farmer family (defined as husband, wife, and minor children) is eligible to receive the benefits. If both husband and wife receive it, one might be asked to refund the amount.
